purpose: Construct a finite complete COVER of source-valid dangerous seven-vertex configurations, parameterized by s=|S|, modulo only proven local color/identity equivalences. No solver and no global compression claim.

scope.final_state: Post-seed-two / post-normalization seeded-precoloring with partition S,X0,X,Y0,Y and U=X union Y.
scope.dangerous_tuple: Ordered seven distinct vertices drawn from role classes S, B=U, C=Y0 representatives, X0, containing at least one C role and at least one X0 role, together with all source/compiler annotations declared below.
scope.grammar_claim: FINITE GRAMMAR PARAMETERIZED BY s=|S|. No absolute finite bound independent of s is claimed here.
scope.cover_not_realizability: Generated cells may over-approximate the realizable source domain. Completeness requires every actual source-valid dangerous tuple to map to a generated cell; it does not require every generated cell to be realizable.

permanent_firewalls.source_vs_exact_palette: For dynamic u: chi_S(u)={f(s):s in N(u) cap S}; chi_X0(u)={f(x):x in N(u) cap X0}; L_P(u)=[4]\chi_S(u); A(u)=[4]\(chi_S(u) union chi_X0(u)). L_P and A are distinct source/compiler objects.
permanent_firewalls.dynamic_identity_redundancy: For a fixed-color X0 identity x0_c not adjacent to u, the counterfactual identity edge is exact-palette-neutral iff c is already in chi_S(u) union chi_X0(u). New identity plus old forbidden color is not a new exact-list constraint.
permanent_firewalls.component_vertex_masks: For z in residual C: chi_X0^C(z)={f(x):x in N(z) cap X0}; B_C(z)=[4]\chi_X0^C(z). X0 is not covered by source axiom (iv), so different vertices of one C may have different X0 masks/base lists.
permanent_firewalls.dynamic_component_uniformity: For every dynamic b in U and connected residual component C, source axiom (iv)+connectedness imply b is complete or anticomplete to C. Hence all selected C-representatives of the same component have identical B-incidence.
permanent_firewalls.component_partition_first: Whether two C roles lie in the same connected residual component is antecedent annotation. Different-component C-C pairs are SOURCE_FORCED_NONEDGE by definition; same-component C-C adjacency is internal G[C] data and does not change component identity.
permanent_firewalls.message_equivalence: For monotone compiled component feasibility, mu_C and MIN_BAD(C) are bijectively equivalent representations of the same message. Store message_type_id canonically and MIN_BAD as replay certificate, not as an independent semantic level.
permanent_firewalls.boundary_relation: The canonical component downstream relation is R_C(gamma)=mu_C({gamma(v):v in D_C}) on legal boundary colorings gamma of the dynamic interface. D_C change can alter R_C even when mu_C is unchanged; D_C change can also be extension-neutral in special cases. No automatic implication is allowed.
semantic_ladder: LOCAL_LIST_DATA: A(u), component base-list system Bsys_C
COMPILED_BOUNDARY_RELATION: R_C determined jointly by D_C and mu_C
permanent_firewalls.representation_vs_extension: A change in a compiler/source representation object is not automatically a change in extension feasibility. EXTENSION_DELTA must be PROVED_NEUTRAL, PROVED_NONNEUTRAL, or UNKNOWN.
permanent_firewalls.counterfactual_cell_firewall: Chord analysis compares source-consistent canonical cells / already-present structural alternatives, not arbitrary one-edge edits. In particular a source-valid B-C edge represents B complete to all of C and must cohere with D_C; a raw single-edge insertion into a nontrivial C is not treated as a valid source transition.
permanent_firewalls.local_vs_global_identity_quotient: Same-color X0 identities may be quotiented for local seven-role inducedness only when fixed color plus local role-incidence profile and cross-X0 adjacency data agree. LOCAL_PROFILE_EQUIVALENCE does not imply GLOBAL_SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE or existential realizability.

seed.canonical_seed: S*={s1,...,ss} with explicit proper coloring f|S* and induced seed adjacency data needed by source scope.
seed.role_type: For any dynamic role, source type tau(u) is stored as a bitset subset of canonical seed positions, not as an opaque numeric id.
seed.derived_checksum: chi_S(u) and L_P(u) are recomputed from tau(u) and f|S*.

fields: incidence/complete-vs-anticomplete bit to each participating component_id
adjacency to participating S/B/X0 identities needed for all 21 pair bits
representative vertex identity class within that component
component base-system identifier Bsys_C or UNKNOWN_INTERNAL when only a cover cell is needed
D_C restricted to participating dynamic B roles
same/different component relation to every other C role
internal C-C adjacency bit for same-component selected representatives
local incidence profile to all participating B and C-representative roles
cross-X0 adjacency profile to all participating X0 roles
for each participating target role r, whether color c was already excluded at r without this identity
X0_role.quotient_key: fixed color + seven-role local incidence profile + cross-X0 adjacency profile; same-color identities with different profiles must not be merged.

examples_firewall: B-B graph change can be PROVED_NEUTRAL for pure list feasibility when A(u) cap A(v)=empty, but reconstruction/downstream scope must still be checked.
B-C / D_C change can be extension-neutral when the resulting boundary relation R_C is unchanged on all legal boundary colorings.
C-X0 base-list-system change does not imply message_type change.
message_type equality does not by itself imply equal R_C if D_C differs.

pruning_rules: Fix component partition before edge census.
If C_i and C_j share component_id, every dynamic B must have equal adjacency to them; otherwise INCONSISTENT_CELL.
If C_i and C_j have different component_id, C_i-C_j is FORCED_NONEDGE.
Same-color X0-X0 edge is forbidden by proper fixed coloring.
All masks/lists must be algebraically consistent with seed coloring and declared X0 profiles.
D_C restricted incidence must agree with dynamic-component complete/anticomplete bits.
MIN_BAD replay certificate must decode to the declared message_type_id.

completeness_contract.map: Phi maps every actual source-valid dangerous ordered seven-tuple in the declared scope to one canonical grammar cell.
must_preserve: all 21 adjacency bits among the seven concrete vertices
fixed-color masks chi_S, chi_X0, representative chi_X0^C
all local X0 color/profile information needed for inducedness and mask redundancy
completeness_contract.overapproximation: Cells need not be source-realizable. Universal positive statements may be proved on a covering superset. Any existential discovery such as a free/redundant chord class requires a source-valid witness or a separate realization theorem before promotion.

finiteness_target.statement: For each fixed s=|S|, the canonical annotation alphabet and the seven-position cell space are finite.
finiteness_target.warning: This finite-cover theorem does not by itself imply a polynomial number of cells in the original input size, nor a polynomial-time global algorithm.

terminals.PASS_COMPLETE_COVERING_GRAMMAR: Coverage map Phi is proved for the declared source scope; every actual dangerous seven-tuple maps to a canonical cell.
terminals.PASS_GLOBAL_FORCED_REPRESENTATION_COST: Within a complete covering grammar, every dangerous chordless cell requires an already-present P7-killing chord whose corresponding source-consistent alternative changes a canonical C0-C3/interface representation object or is source-forbidden.
terminals.PASS_REPRESENTATION_REDUNDANT_CLASS: A source-valid witness or realization theorem proves an identity/graph distinction that leaves the chosen compiler projection invariant.
terminals.PASS_EXTENSION_NEUTRAL_CLASS: A source-valid witness plus exact downstream adequacy/reconstruction proof establishes that a structural distinction leaves the full frozen extension contract unchanged.
terminals.OPEN_GRAMMAR_COMPLETENESS: Phi or a required annotation-completeness obligation is not proved.

falsifiers: An actual source-valid dangerous seven-tuple cannot be mapped while preserving any field in the completeness contract.
Two locally quotiented X0 identities with the same proposed key yield different seven-role adjacency/mask observations required by the census.
A claimed PROVED_NEUTRAL or PROVED_NONNEUTRAL extension delta lacks an exact downstream query/reconstruction adequacy proof.
Generator completeness relies on enumerating unbounded internal component structure rather than using a declared finite cover annotation.
